text.arabic_uthmani: إِنَّمَا ٱلْمُؤْمِنُونَ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ بِٱللَّهِ وَرَسُولِهِۦ ثُمَّ لَمْ يَرْتَابُوا۟ وَجَٰهَدُوا۟ بِأَمْوَٰلِهِمْ وَأَنفُسِهِمْ فِى سَبِيلِ ٱللَّهِ ۚ أُو۟لَٰٓئِكَ هُمُ ٱلصَّٰدِقُونَ

words.gloss_range: restrictive particle opening a definitional exclusion frame
words.prose: With {{ar:إِنَّمَا}} ({{tr:innamā}}), the ayah enters as restriction before the subject even appears: the particle does not merely emphasize belief but sets an exclusion frame. Its fused form redirects the force of inna into definition, so the following criteria answer the suspended claim of 49:14 and later close in a verdict rather than a loose description.

topics.headline: restrictive opening defines the category
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the ayah begins by excluding rival believer-claims before it lists the criteria.
topics.reason: The rows converge on the fused inna-plus-ma form, its cancelled inna governance, and its sentence-wide restriction, with 49:10 and 49:14 confirming a local definitional context.

words.gloss_range: definite plural active participle naming the believer class under restriction
words.root_gloss_range: security, trust, entrusting, and reliability; local grammar selects the believer class rather than every root branch
words.prose: {{ar:ٱلْمُؤْمِنُونَ}} ({{tr:al-muʾminūna}}) names a known class, but the opening restriction prevents the label from standing on its own. The {{ar:أ م ن}} ({{tr:ʾ-m-n}}) field gives the class a trust-security and entrusted-reliability charge, while the following verb from the same root makes the title prove itself in action after the denial of 49:14 and alongside the believer definition of 49:10.

topics.headline: believer label becomes a tested class
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the known believer label is reopened as a class that must be proven by trust, steadiness, and striving.
topics.reason: The active participle and article make a recognized class, while the root rows add trust-security and entrusted-responsibility pressure; that pressure is kept as coloring, not a replacement for the local class noun.

words.gloss_range: definite plural relative pronoun serving as predicate and head of the criteria
words.prose: {{ar:ٱلَّذِينَ}} ({{tr:alladhīna}}) is the hinge that turns the believer title into a profile of actions. As a definite plural relative, it gathers the later plural verbs under one head, so completed trust, non-wavering, and striving do not describe separate groups but one bounded class.

topics.headline: relative clause turns title into criteria
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that identity is defined by a bounded action-profile, not by a bare title.
topics.reason: The relative pronoun functions as predicate of the believer class and supplies the plural head for the later pro-drop verbs, so all criteria stay attached to the same group.

words.gloss_range: Form IV perfect trust-act directed by a governed complement
words.root_gloss_range: trust, security, making safe, and entrusting; local prepositional frame selects believing or trusting in its objects
words.prose: {{ar:ءَامَنُوا۟}} ({{tr:āmanū}}) gives the first criterion as an accomplished act by the same group named through the relative pronoun. The {{ar:أ م ن}} ({{tr:ʾ-m-n}}) field keeps security and reliability in the background, but the bi-governed construction selects directed trust in God and His messenger; unlike the broader formula seen in 4:136, 57:7, and 64:8, this occurrence is immediately followed by a non-retraction test.

topics.headline: completed trust is directed and then tested
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that belief is presented as a completed directed commitment, then immediately tested by an interval of non-doubt.
topics.reason: The perfect 3mp form, Form IV morphology, governed bi-complement, and boundary with 49:14 support completed commitment; the causative security image is retained as lexical pressure but narrowed by the local trust construction.

words.gloss_range: bound preposition marking the governed object of trust
words.prose: {{ar:بِ}} ({{tr:bi}}) is small, but it makes the trust-act governed and directed. Here its object-marking force is primary, while its bound form audibly and graphically leans into the divine name and opens the complement that the next conjunction expands.

topics.headline: preposition directs the trust object
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the belief verb is not left generic; it is routed into a specific object relation.
topics.reason: The rows distinguish this object-marking bi from other trust frames and show it beginning the compound complement expanded by the following conjunction.

words.gloss_range: proper divine name as genitive object governed by the trust preposition
words.root_gloss_range: deity, worship, refuge, and disputed bewilderment pressure; local role is the proper name as object of trust
words.prose: {{ar:ٱللَّهِ}} ({{tr:Allāhi}}) is not a generic sacred target but the proper divine name under prepositional governance. The {{ar:أ ل ه}} ({{tr:ʾ-l-h}}) pressure of worship and refuge colors why trust is directed here, and the same name later returns at the path-position, making the criteria move from God as trust-object to God as route-owner.

topics.headline: divine name anchors the belief object
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that God is the governed trust-object here and will return as the owner of the path later.
topics.reason: Grammar makes the name genitive under bi, while lexical rows keep worship/refuge pressure and corpus rows connect the name to trust and its later path position; generic deity readings are blocked by the proper name.

words.gloss_range: coordinating particle binding the second trust object to the first
words.prose: {{ar:وَ}} ({{tr:wa}}) bridges rather than restarts. It keeps the next noun under the same governed trust relation, so belief in God and His messenger forms one coordinated object structure instead of two unrelated claims.

topics.headline: conjunction shares the trust governor
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the messenger is not a separate add-on but shares the same governed belief relation.
topics.reason: The conjunction coordinates the messenger with the divine name under the same bi-governed complement, and its wasl prevents separating the two trust targets.

words.gloss_range: genitive coordinated messenger noun with divine possessive suffix
words.root_gloss_range: sending, releasing, dispatch, and message-bearing; local sense is the possessed messenger-office
words.prose: {{ar:رَسُولِهِۦ}} ({{tr:rasūlihī}}) joins the trust-object as a possessed envoy-office: the suffix makes the messenger relation belong to God, and the genitive coordination keeps it under the same belief frame. The {{ar:ر س ل}} ({{tr:r-s-l}}) field contributes sending and dispatch, so the trusted figure is a channel from the sender, especially after the obedience context of 49:14.

topics.headline: messenger office is relational and sent
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the messenger is trusted as God-related envoy, not as an independent authority detached from the sender.
topics.reason: Genitive coordination locks the noun to the same trust object, the suffix routes the office to God, and the sending-root rows are retained as role pressure without turning the word into the message itself.

words.gloss_range: sequencing conjunction marking delay and escalation
words.prose: {{ar:ثُمَّ}} ({{tr:thumma}}) slows the criteria down. Instead of linking belief to non-doubt as an immediate afterthought, it creates a delayed and graded pivot: completed trust must survive an interval, answering the not-yet horizon from 49:14 with tested endurance.

topics.headline: delayed pivot tests completed trust
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the ayah inserts time and escalation between believing and not doubting, making endurance part of the definition.
topics.reason: The rows contrast thumma with immediate connectors, note the unique thumma-lam-yartabu sequence in 49:15, and show the pivot from initial commitment to tested persistence.

words.gloss_range: jussive negator scoping over the doubt verb with past-negative force
words.prose: {{ar:لَمْ}} ({{tr:lam}}) turns the middle of the definition into a negative test. Its scope and jussive force make wavering absent after the interval, so the ayah does not merely ask for belief but for belief that has not broken into doubt.

topics.headline: negation makes non-doubt a criterion
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the middle criterion is not extra knowledge but the total negation of wavering after belief.
topics.reason: Lam scopes over the imperfect, triggers jussive apocopation, and creates a past-negative non-doubt clause that contrasts the prior not-yet-belief scene.

words.gloss_range: Form VIII jussive verb for entering or generating doubt under negation
words.root_gloss_range: disquieting doubt, disturbance, suspicion, and rare verbalized rayb; local clause negates such internal wavering
words.prose: {{ar:يَرْتَابُوا۟}} ({{tr:yartābū}}) names the wavering that the definition refuses. The {{ar:ر ي ب}} ({{tr:r-y-b}}) rows make this more than ordinary inquiry: it is disquieting, self-involving rayb, here negated by lam and tied to the same plural group; the no-doubt resonance with 2:2 sharpens the criterion without changing the local verb.

topics.headline: doubt is inner disquiet, not inquiry
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that what is excluded is self-involving disquiet that unsettles commitment, not honest questioning as such.
topics.reason: The Form VIII and lam-jussive grammar make the verb internal and negated, while lexical rows distinguish rayb-style disturbance from inquiry; the 2:2 echo is a contrast in no-doubt language, not control of the local parse.

words.gloss_range: coordinating particle adding the striving verb after the non-doubt clause
words.prose: {{ar:وَ}} ({{tr:wa}}) opens the third criterion after the negative middle clause has closed. Its coordination gives the coming action equal status with belief and non-doubt, moving the ayah from inner steadiness into outward exertion.

topics.headline: connector adds action as third criterion
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that action is coordinated as an equal criterion after inner non-doubt.
topics.reason: The conjunction coordinates striving with the prior predicates and resets the cadence into action, preserving equal criterion status rather than a subordinate afterthought.

words.gloss_range: Form III perfect striving verb framed by means and path-domain complements
words.root_gloss_range: utmost effort, capacity, exertion, and reciprocal struggle; local sense is accomplished striving with specified means and domain
words.prose: {{ar:جَٰهَدُوا۟}} ({{tr:jāhadū}}) completes the criteria as an accomplished action by the same group. The {{ar:ج ه د}} ({{tr:j-h-d}}) field contributes utmost-capacity and reciprocal exertion, while the syntax keeps that exertion local: it is framed by means in possessions and selves and by a path-domain, producing a positive-negative-positive crescendo after trust and non-doubt.

topics.headline: striving completes the belief sequence
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the final criterion is accomplished exertion using possessions and selves within a defined path.
topics.reason: The perfect plural verb repeats the same subject, Form III supplies exertion pressure, and the following bi and fi phrases specify means and domain; broader struggle imagery is narrowed to this local construction.

words.gloss_range: bound instrumental preposition introducing the means of striving
words.prose: {{ar:بِ}} ({{tr:bi}}) assigns means. Bound to the next noun, it makes possessions the instrument of striving and prepares the coordinated instrument pair rather than treating resources as a separate topic.

topics.headline: instrumental preposition makes resources means
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that wealth is not just mentioned beside striving; it is grammatically made a means of it.
topics.reason: The rows identify instrumental bi governed by the striving verb and show it preparing the paired instrument chain of wealth and selves.

words.gloss_range: possessed plural wealth noun governed as the first instrument of striving
words.root_gloss_range: possession, accumulated property, and material resources; local plural covers personal assets deployed as means
words.prose: {{ar:أَمْوَٰلِهِمْ}} ({{tr:amwālihim}}) makes the external stake personal: the suffix ties the assets to the same believers, and the instrumental grammar turns owned resources into a means of striving. The {{ar:م و ل}} ({{tr:m-w-l}}) background of accumulated possession, even with older concrete wealth imagery, is narrowed here to personal material resources that come before the selves in the Quranic wealth-and-self order found in 9:20, 9:41, 9:88, and 61:11.

topics.headline: personal wealth becomes expendable means
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the believers' own material resources become the first named instrument of verified commitment.
topics.reason: The noun is genitive under instrumental bi, the 3mp suffix returns possession to the same group, and lexical rows broaden mal into accumulated resources; camel-wealth imagery is retained as grounding, not a narrow local translation.

words.gloss_range: coordinating particle binding the second possessed instrument to the first
words.prose: {{ar:وَ}} ({{tr:wa}}) keeps the second instrument from being swallowed by the first. It binds the selves to the same instrumental frame while preserving a real move from owned resources to personal being.

topics.headline: connector preserves the second instrument
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that selves are added as a distinct equal instrument, not collapsed into wealth.
topics.reason: The conjunction coordinates the second possessed noun under the same instrumental frame and keeps the wealth-self pair distinct while equal.

words.gloss_range: possessed plural selves noun coordinated as the second instrument of striving
words.root_gloss_range: self, soul, person, life, breath, desire, and relief; local plural marks personal selves or lives as committed means
words.prose: {{ar:أَنفُسِهِمْ}} ({{tr:anfusihim}}) carries the inner side of the instrument pair. The suffix makes the selves personally bound to the same group, while the {{ar:ن ف س}} ({{tr:n-f-s}}) field of self, life, breath, and desire gives the phrase more depth than a generic possession; after the hearts problem of 49:14 and the self-harm warning of 49:11, the inner locus turns toward committed self-giving.

topics.headline: selves mark inward personal stake
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that commitment moves from external assets to the believers own selves, making the sacrifice inward and personal.
topics.reason: The noun shares the instrumental role with wealth, the suffix binds it to the same group, and the breath/self/desire rows intensify the personal stake without requiring a single narrow English equivalent.

words.gloss_range: preposition marking the domain or containment frame of striving
words.prose: {{ar:فِى}} ({{tr:fī}}) changes the question from what they use to where their exertion belongs. Its containment-domain force places striving within a path, and the attachment can color either the verb or the whole predicate while still bounding the action ethically and directionally.

topics.headline: path preposition bounds the striving domain
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that striving is not valid in any direction; it is placed within a path-domain.
topics.reason: The preposition governs the path noun as domain of striving, with local ambiguity allowing it to frame the verb or the whole predicate without breaking the syntax.

words.gloss_range: singular construct path noun governed by fi and governing the divine possessor
words.root_gloss_range: road, path, way, means, mode, and flowing course; local fi-frame foregrounds path or domain while means remains secondary coloring
words.prose: {{ar:سَبِيلِ}} ({{tr:sabīli}}) is the route that receives the exertion. The {{ar:س ب ل}} ({{tr:s-b-l}}) range includes road, way, means, mode, and flowing course, but the local fi-frame foregrounds path-domain: resources and selves are not static offerings, they are directed along one construct-bound route that closes the active investment beat.

topics.headline: singular divine path directs exertion
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that possessions and selves are released along one God-defined route, not spent in an undefined cause.
topics.reason: The noun is both governed by fi and head of the construct, while lexical rows give road/means and flowing-course pressure; singular construct and corpus pairing narrow the phrase to a defined divine path-domain.

words.gloss_range: proper divine name as genitive possessor defining the path
words.root_gloss_range: deity, worship, refuge, and disputed bewilderment pressure; local role is path-owner in construct
words.prose: {{ar:ٱللَّهِ}} ({{tr:Allāhi}}) now functions as possessor of the path, not as another object of the striving verb. The {{ar:أ ل ه}} ({{tr:ʾ-l-h}}) worship/refuge pressure is activated through ownership, and the repetition of the divine name creates a God-to-God arc: trust begins with Him and action is bounded by His path before the final verdict lands.

topics.headline: second divine name owns the path
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the God-to-God arc: the one trusted at the start is the one who owns the route of action.
topics.reason: The second divine name is genitive as construct possessor, not another object of striving, and its repetition frames the criteria from trust-object to path-owner before the verdict.

words.gloss_range: distal demonstrative restarting the closing nominal verdict clause
words.prose: {{ar:أُو۟لَٰٓئِكَ}} ({{tr:ʾulāʾika}}) restarts the sentence at the point of judgment. Its distal pointing gathers all prior criteria into one deictic target, then works with the following separating pronoun to repeat restriction at the close; the same verdict stamp appears elsewhere in the surah, including 49:7.

topics.headline: demonstrative gathers criteria into verdict
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices a pause-then-judgment structure that gathers the whole criteria chain into one pointer.
topics.reason: The demonstrative begins a new nominal clause, points back to the described group, joins the humu-predicate restriction, and participates in the surah verdict pattern also seen in 49:7.

words.gloss_range: independent separating pronoun between demonstrative and definite predicate
words.prose: {{ar:هُمُ}} ({{tr:humu}}) is the structural separator that lets the verdict land. By standing independently between pointer and predicate, it blocks a merely adjectival reading and intensifies the claim: the described ones are the truthful ones, set against the addressed claimants of 49:14.

topics.headline: separating pronoun intensifies identity verdict
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the final label is forced as an exclusive predicate verdict, not a flowing modifier.
topics.reason: The pronoun functions as damir al-fasl, blocks adjectival reading, creates a pause before the predicate, and seals the third-person benchmark against the prior addressed claimants.

words.gloss_range: definite plural active participle serving as the final predicate verdict
words.root_gloss_range: truth, correspondence, sincerity, giving, friendship, and effective hitting-the-mark; local sense is verified truthfulness of claim and conduct
words.prose: {{ar:ٱلصَّٰدِقُونَ}} ({{tr:aṣ-ṣādiqūn}}) is the final predicate, not a second believer label. The {{ar:ص د ق}} ({{tr:ṣ-d-q}}) field centers truth as correspondence between claim and reality, with hitting-the-mark force made vivid by the exertion context; broader charity and sincere-relation resonances remain coloring. Thus the ayah opens by defining believers but closes by naming the verified truthful, a standard that meets the later truth challenge of 49:17 and echoes the closing pattern of 49:7 and the wider truth-axis of 19:41 and 19:56.

topics.headline: truthfulness is the verified output
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the ayah defines believers but ends by verifying them as truthful, making truth the output of the whole chain.
topics.reason: Predicate grammar, definiteness, and the separating pronoun make an exclusive verdict; lexical rows add claim-reality correspondence and effective hitting-the-mark pressure, while charity/friendship links are retained only as root-family coloring.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The doubled ء م ن forms at words 2 and 4 lead through ثم لم يرتابوا and the paired instruments بأموالهم وأنفسهم to هم الصادقون.
baseline_models.mechanism: Settled assent is exposed to disturbing doubt, then confirmed by spending both owned resources and the living self at the limit of capacity along God's route. Truth is therefore correspondence enacted under cost, not a second verbal claim.

activation_trace.role: Settled security and trust supply the stable inward condition that the following clauses test.
Trusting assent supplies the initial confirmation that later conduct must make durable.
Disturbing doubt and suspicion name the destabilizing pressure that does not dislodge assent.
Capacity spent under strain turns inward confidence into costly exertion.
Acquired wealth supplies the alienable outer reserve placed into the exertion.
The living soul-self supplies the non-alienable inner stake paired with property.
An extended traversed way gives the expenditure direction rather than making cost an end in itself.
Fulfillment in action makes the final truth predicate the realized confirmation of the opening assent.

changed_reading.before: The ayah lists correct belief, absence of doubt, and sacrifice as traits of believers.
changed_reading.after: The ayah traces a verification circuit: settled assent survives destabilization and becomes truthful by converting both property and living self into directed action.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The delayed connector ثم and negated يرتابوا stand between initial assent and sustained exertion.
baseline_models.mechanism: The time-and-death branch of ريب makes the middle clause a durability test across later reversals, while the traversed way and fulfillment branches make truth a maintained course. The sequence measures continuity, not the intensity of an inaugural moment.

activation_trace.role: Settled security supplies the state whose persistence is being measured.
Uncertain turns of time and death give ثم a field of intervening reversals through which trust persists.
Continued expenditure of capacity shows endurance after the interval rather than a momentary profession.
A traversed route supplies extension through time and a course that must be kept.
Solidity and straightness make truth the structural durability of the whole sequence.

changed_reading.before: Certainty and striving are adjacent virtues.
changed_reading.after: Truth is longitudinal: trust stays straight through intervening reversals and continues to bear cost along a route.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The parallel بأموالهم وأنفسهم names two instruments of جاهدوا before the directional phrase في سبيل الله.
baseline_models.mechanism: The pairing inventories an outer reserve that can be possessed and an irreducible self that cannot be detached. Striving mobilizes both stores and converts held value into movement; the final truth predicate names completed conversion rather than mere sincerity of feeling.

activation_trace.role: Draining something through use, including property exhausted by giving, supplies a material conversion model for striving.
Acquired property is the detachable reserve available for transfer.
The very thing itself makes the second reserve the agent's whole identity, not merely another possession.
Precious value desired by selves explains why mobilizing the self is the costliest transfer.
The route converts depletion into directed circulation rather than waste.
Fulfillment makes mobilized reserves the performance of a prior commitment.

changed_reading.before: Wealth and lives are two examples of sacrifice.
changed_reading.after: They are a deliberate two-reserve inventory: what one has and what one is are both converted from possession into movement on God's route.

context_deltas.mechanism: The messenger branch of deliberate pace joins prohibitions against advancing, elevating one's voice, and the positive lowering of voice. Because belief in the messenger precedes striving in 49:15, exertion becomes paced and answerable movement rather than self-authorizing acceleration.

activation_trace.role: Gentleness and deliberate pace supply a tempo latent in allegiance to the messenger.
Strained capacity is the energetic force that now requires pacing and authorization.
Forward precedence supplies the prohibited motion of outrunning God and the messenger.
Raising something supplies the prohibited vertical assertion of one's own voice.
Holding back and lowering by reduction supplies the positive discipline that channels force.
The repeated messenger reference activates deliberate pace in the immediate scene of lowered voices.

structural_cues: 49:1-3 repeatedly regulate precedence, height, and volume around the messenger.
In 49:15 allegiance to the messenger occurs before the delayed transition to striving.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a messenger-associated tempo and three controls on self-assertion; I infer that these controls govern the later force of جاهدوا. A live alternative is that the opening etiquette rules and 49:15's striving remain independent domains.

changed_reading.before: Belief in the messenger and strenuous action are separate credentials.
changed_reading.after: Belief in the messenger calibrates strenuous action: truthful zeal moves at an authorized, restrained pace and cannot outrun or over-voice its source.

context_deltas.mechanism: Lowering an available voice is a real expenditure of impulse, and the adjacent heart-test reveals and refines what that restraint contains. This broadens maximum effort in 49:15 to include costly inhibition, not only visible output.

activation_trace.role: Spending capacity under strain supplies the broader category into which disciplined restraint can enter.
Solidity and straightness make controlled force, not maximum display, the mark of truth.
Holding back and reducing supplies a concrete act in which capacity is spent by not discharging it.
A test that reveals what is in the heart turns restraint into diagnostic pressure.
Refinement after testing supplies a transformative result rather than mere exposure.
The pure core locates the object revealed and refined by restrained conduct.

structural_cues: 49:3 places lowered voices immediately beside tested hearts.
49:15 leaves the object of جاهدوا open while naming wealth and selves as instruments.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies reduction of voice, testing, and heart; I infer that voluntary inhibition is one form of strained self-expenditure. The alternative is that voice etiquette only evidences piety and does not expand the semantic range of striving.

changed_reading.before: Striving primarily means force projected outward.
changed_reading.after: Striving can also consume capacity inwardly: withholding an available impulse under pressure may be the action that reveals and refines a truthful heart.

context_deltas.mechanism: The context distinguishes an arriving report from the work of making it clear, while later separating corrosive suspicion from covert investigation. Therefore لم يرتابوا cannot simply reward untested acceptance; it names trust that refuses anxious destabilization while retaining disciplined verification.

activation_trace.role: Trusting assent supplies confidence, but not yet the method by which reports are handled.
Disturbing suspicion identifies the corrosive state negated by the focus clause.
Clarifying meaning through statement or sign supplies an active verification procedure.
A report arriving and being conveyed supplies the uncertain input that must be tested rather than absorbed.
Doubt and imagining supply the ungrounded cognition from which believers are told to keep distance.
Bad suspicion of people identifies the socially destructive specialization of that cognition.
Secret tracking of reports marks the opposite excess: verification must not become invasive surveillance.

structural_cues: 49:6 commands clarification before action on a report because error harms a people.
49:12 prohibits both much suspicion and covert investigation, placing epistemic limits on opposite sides.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies report, clarification, suspicion, and spying as a bounded sequence; I infer that non-doubt in 49:15 is stable, disciplined trust rather than incuriosity. A live alternative is that the focus clause concerns only doubt about God while the context rules concern other people.

changed_reading.before: True believers never question and accept without hesitation.
changed_reading.after: True believers are not credulous: they verify incoming claims, refuse corrosive suspicion, and do not let either uncertainty or surveillance displace settled trust.

context_deltas.mechanism: Faith's attraction and beauty are given to the heart as favor, and 49:17 reverses the believers' attempted direction of benefaction by naming divine guidance to faith. The exertion of 49:15 thus fulfills a received orientation; it cannot become an invoice presented to God.

activation_trace.role: Costly exertion supplies the achievement most liable to be misread as self-originating merit.
Fulfillment in action lets deeds confirm a prior gift without turning them into its cause.
Love lodged in the heart supplies an attraction to faith that the subjects do not manufacture in this scene.
Making something appear beautiful supplies a prior shaping of inward desire.
Benefaction and gift classify that inward shaping as received surplus.
Burdening a recipient by rehearsing one's favor supplies the rejected accounting model.
Gentle indication toward the true road supplies the reversed, divine direction of benefit.
The repeated fulfillment branch directly makes truthful action the test of whether guided faith has been realized.

structural_cues: 49:7-8 attributes faith's attractiveness to God and names it favor and gift.
49:17 rejects a claimed favor toward the messenger, reverses the favor toward divine guidance, and repeats the truth condition.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies attraction, adornment, gift, rejected boasting, and guidance; I infer causal priority for received orientation over human expenditure. Human effort may still coexist as a real response rather than being reduced to passivity.

changed_reading.before: Costly striving earns or establishes the believer's claim to status.
changed_reading.after: Costly striving verifies a gifted orientation but cannot indebt God; truth includes refusing to convert one's response into leverage or self-congratulation.

context_deltas.mechanism: Two parties can be called believers and brothers while mutually fighting and requiring repair. Against that local usage, إنما المؤمنون in 49:15 reads less like cancellation of every defective member and more like naming the realized, truth-bearing performance of the identity.

activation_trace.role: Trusting assent supplies the identity whose fully realized form the focus ayah describes.
Fulfillment in action makes الصادقون an achievement predicate rather than merely a second group label.
Believer naming remains attached to the two parties before their conduct has been repaired.
Mutual combat supplies severe conduct that coexists with the contextual believer designation.
Removing estrangement supplies a repair path internal to the named community.
The repeated المؤمنون designation preserves a trust-bearing communal frame after conflict.
Brotherhood and kinship keep defective parties inside a relation that can be restored.

structural_cues: 49:9 grammatically labels both fighting parties as believers before commanding correction.
49:10 restates المؤمنون with إنما yet predicates brotherhood and repair rather than the 49:15 sequence.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies broad believer naming amid grave failure and a repair command; I infer that 49:15 intensifies the truth of the name rather than furnishing an exhaustive social exclusion test. The alternative is a deliberate distinction between a broad legal category in 49:9-10 and a strict ontological category in 49:15.

changed_reading.before: إنما draws a Boolean boundary: anyone missing a listed trait is simply outside the believer category.
changed_reading.after: إنما profiles realized fidelity: conflicted believers can remain repairable siblings, while 49:15 names those whose assent has become fully correspondent action.

context_deltas.mechanism: The reflexive أنفسكم in a prohibition on attacking other members, read beside brotherhood as a binding tie, makes selfhood socially distributed. The أنفسهم spent in 49:15 can therefore include the relational self whose dignity, bonds, and repair are put into God's way, alongside the individual life.

activation_trace.role: The very self or whole identity supplies an anchor broad enough to carry personal and relational identity.
Capacity spent under strain supplies the cost of maintaining and repairing a shared self.
A binding tie supplies the relation through which distinct people can be treated as one another's self.
Faulting by attack supplies the interpersonal act expressed reflexively as injury to yourselves.
The same whole-self branch in أنفسكم lets harm to another member rebound as harm to the collective self.

structural_cues: 49:11 uses a plural reflexive object for an interpersonal prohibition.
49:10 has already bound the believers as siblings requiring mutual repair.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies reflexive grammar and a brotherly bond; I infer a distributed communal self that can be spent and protected. The live alternative is that أنفسكم is only an idiom for one another and should not reshape أنفسهم in 49:15.

changed_reading.before: Their selves means each believer's private body or life.
changed_reading.after: Their selves can coexist as individual lives and a shared relational identity, so costly striving includes protecting, repairing, and refusing to wound the communal self.

context_deltas.mechanism: The context images humanity as branches that both divide and join, groups facing one another, and recognition produced from marks. This can activate سبيل الله as social infrastructure: wealth and whole selves are spent to make difference traversable and mutual knowledge possible.

activation_trace.role: An extended traversed way supplies the connective infrastructure of the reading.
Possessed resources supply the material that can build and maintain a social route.
Whole identity supplies the personal exposure required to cross inherited group boundaries.
Branching and separation supply the plurality that a route must cross.
Joining and mending a split supplies the coexistence of differentiation with reconnection.
A group whose parts face one another supplies reciprocal orientation rather than isolated identity.
Recognition by sign supplies the social result toward which the route is directed.

structural_cues: 49:13 gives differentiation into peoples and tribes the stated purpose of mutual recognition.
49:15 directs both property and whole selves into a way rather than naming an object to be defeated.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies branching groups, reciprocal facing, recognition, and a traversed way; I infer that one possible work of the way is building passage across social divisions. The alternative is that 49:13 only supplies a ranking ethic and leaves the concrete content of striving unspecified.

changed_reading.before: God's way is an already given arena into which resources are expended.
changed_reading.after: God's way can also be made socially traversable: resources and identity become infrastructure for recognition across branches that remain distinct.

context_deltas.mechanism: 49:14 separates spoken self-description from faith's entry into the heart and leaves obedience possible during that unfinished ingress. Read back into 49:15, the clauses form a flow from assent installed in the core, through stabilized non-doubt, into outward expenditure, with truth naming successful transmission across the whole path.

activation_trace.role: Trusting assent supplies the content that must become inwardly installed rather than merely pronounced.
Absence of disturbing suspicion marks stabilization after ingress.
Fulfillment makes the endpoint correspondence between inner installation and outward conduct.
Produced speech supplies the external claim that can precede the inward state.
Repeated assent language supplies the disputed state whose location matters.
Entering an interior supplies the directional movement from claim into core.
The pure inner core supplies the destination of faith's ingress.
Compliant obedience supplies outward movement that can begin while inward formation remains incomplete.

structural_cues: 49:14 explicitly contrasts a spoken perfect claim with faith not yet having entered the hearts.
49:15 orders assent, stabilization, expenditure, and truth as successive clauses.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies an outside-inside contrast and an ordered focus sequence; I infer a transmission model from speech through core to conduct. A live alternative is that 49:14 describes stages of distinct people while 49:15 simply lists simultaneous traits.

changed_reading.before: 49:15 supplies a static checklist for identifying believers.
changed_reading.after: 49:15 maps a successful ingress-and-outflow process: assent reaches the core, stabilizes there, and exits as costly conduct whose correspondence is called truth.

context_deltas.mechanism: The closing context rejects informing God about one's religion, spans the hidden heavens and earth, and joins inward sight to performed work. The truth predicate of 49:15 is therefore not self-certification or reputation but correspondence between hidden orientation and visible action under a witness who accesses both.

activation_trace.role: Hidden thought and intent supply the inward side of the correspondence being judged.
Correspondence of speech with inward belief and reported reality supplies the truth relation.
Fulfillment in action supplies the visible side that confirms inward orientation.
Disclosure to the knower makes attempted self-report informationally redundant.
Obedience and submission supply the claimed religious state that speakers cannot certify for God.
What is concealed from eyes supplies the domain unavailable to communal reputation.
Insight of the heart supplies penetration beyond external display.
Intentional work supplies the observable output joined to hidden intent.

structural_cues: 49:16 immediately challenges the attempt to tell God the state of one's religion.
49:18 closes the sequence by pairing knowledge of the unseen with sight of what people do.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a rejected self-report, hidden knowledge, inward sight, and performed work; I infer that these establish the evaluator and two sides of صدق. The alternative is that omniscience only warns or reassures and does not define the mechanism of the focus predicate.

changed_reading.before: The final label reports a status recognizable from the community's visible checklist.
changed_reading.after: The final label is a correspondence verdict no claimant can issue for oneself: hidden intent and visible expenditure agree under comprehensive knowledge and sight.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it activates a place-image of جهد under a verbal occurrence. It remains anchored by جاهدوا, the explicit path construction, and the solidity branch of صدق; downstream prose should present exposed ground as a spatial metaphor for accountable action, not as the lexical gloss of the verb.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: جاهدوا at word 10 stands beside في سبيل at word 14 and culminates in الصادقون at word 18.

activation_trace.role: Hard exposed ground spatializes effort as leaving shelter for an open testing surface.
The traversed way joins the exposed surface into a coherent spatial scene.
Solidity and straightness make truth what remains load-bearing on exposed ground.

changed_reading.before: Profession and sacrifice can be assessed as discrete credentials.
changed_reading.after: The ayah can image truth as leaving sheltered profession for exposed ground, where a straight, load-bearing commitment becomes publicly testable.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This cross-domain reading is surprising because نفس as exhaled breath is distant from the ordinary plural-self construction. It remains anchored in أنفسهم and is activated by the context's regulation of audible voice; downstream prose should say that breath imagery flickers beneath embodied self-expenditure, not replace selves with breaths.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: أنفسهم at word 12 is an instrument of جاهدوا, while الصادقون can carry truth in speech as well as fulfillment.

activation_trace.role: Breath leaving the body gives self-expenditure an embodied respiratory register.
Capacity spent under strain turns breath into a finite bodily budget.
Truth in speech links the bodily budget to the utterance it powers.
Audible sound supplies the context in which breath becomes socially consequential output.
Lowering by holding back supplies governance of that output rather than mere silence.

changed_reading.before: Spending the self primarily evokes risking one's body or life.
changed_reading.after: A bodily undertone appears: truthful effort governs a finite breath budget, knowing when to spend voice and when restraint itself spends the self.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is odd because it chains peripheral material branches of سبيل and نفس into an ecological scene. The chain remains focus-rooted and the sky-earth frame in 49:18 closes its vertical geometry; downstream prose should retain it only as an image of circulating provision, never as a replacement meaning for سبيل الله.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: Wealth and selves are drained into سبيل الله, whose focus inventory includes downward rain and the extended ear of grain.

activation_trace.role: Draining property by use or giving supplies release from storage into circulation.
Life-sustaining water makes the self one of the provisions that keeps life standing.
Falling rain turns the way into a downward channel of released provision.
The extended ear of grain supplies the growth produced after provision reaches receptive ground.
The sky as what rises and overshadows supplies the upper source of the vertical scene.
Soft fertile earth supplies the receiving surface on which released provision can grow.

changed_reading.before: Resources disappear as the cost of travel on an abstract divine path.
changed_reading.after: An ecological image coexists: held value is released like rain into a life-bearing channel and reappears as growth rather than simply vanishing.

strongest_changes: لم يرتابوا became disciplined, non-credulous stability bounded by verification on one side and suspicion or spying on the other.
The conflicted believers and brotherhood of 49:9-10 changed إنما from a simple exclusion test into a profile of fully realized fidelity.
The gift-and-guidance reversal of 49:7-8 and 49:17 made costly action confirmation of received orientation rather than leverage over God.
49:14 and 49:16-18 turned the focus sequence into correspondence between inward installation and visible action under comprehensive knowledge.
summary.what_was_special: The focus ayah supported several coexisting mechanisms: a cost-bearing verification circuit, durability across reversals, a two-reserve conversion, authorized and restrained force, distributed selfhood, and a route of mutual recognition. Peripheral branches also preserved exposed-ground, breath, and ecological images without promoting them to lexical replacements.
remaining_uncertainties: إنما may still distinguish a stricter category from the broader social use of believers rather than only intensifying one identity.
The distributed-self and mutual-recognition readings depend on carrying nearby reflexive and social structures back into the focus ayah.
The exposed-ground, breath, and ecological outliers are branch-anchored but remain metaphorical and should not be rendered as direct glosses.

reader_a.activated_readings_md:
1. **Faith is temporal steadiness after assent.** ء م ن B001/B002 supplies settled trust and confirmation; ر ي ب B001 is disturbing doubt and B002 the uncertain turns of time and death. The structural cue is *thumma* followed by non-doubt. I infer that truthfulness is tested by whether assent remains settled through later turns, not by the initial declaration alone. Faith becomes durable orientation.
2. **Truth takes material form through spent capacity.** ج ه د B001 (spending capacity under strain), م و ل B001 (acquiring/having wealth), and ن ف س B010/B013 (precious value; hidden intent) place both external holdings and interior self on س ب ل B001, the extended traversed way. The packet supplies coordinated striving with wealth and selves. I infer that inward trust becomes observable by being carried over a costly route. Neither profession nor possession alone completes the mechanism.
3. **The truthful are made solid by fulfillment.** ص د ق B001 gives speech-truth, B002 solidity/straightness, and B004 confirmation/fulfillment. The final identity follows belief, non-doubt, and striving. I infer that the sequence hardens a spoken claim into fulfilled structure. "The truthful" names congruence between utterance, temporal endurance, and expenditure.
4. **The path also tests exposure.** ج ه د B004 (hard exposed ground) and B007 (emerging into view) are exploratory beside س ب ل B001. The packet gives strenuous movement on a way; I infer that commitment becomes visible where the route removes shelter. The ayah reads as public verification of the heart without reducing faith to publicity.
reader_a.retrospective_surprises_md: 49:16-18 shifted the verification of truth away from self-certification: religion cannot inform God, guidance itself is favor, and hidden motives are seen. This retrospectively makes striving evidence of congruence without making it an autonomous purchase of faithful status.

reader_a.activated_readings_md:
1. **Truthful faith is correspondence sustained through time, not the successful utterance of a claim.** `ء م ن:B002` supplies trusting assent and `ء م ن:B001` settled safety or trust, while `ر ي ب:B001` is doubt that agitates into suspicion. The sequence **ءَامَنُوا۟ ... ثُمَّ لَمْ يَرْتَابُوا۟** gives initial assent a later test; its conclusion activates `ص د ق:B001`, correspondence of speech with inward belief and the reported reality, and `ص د ق:B004`, fulfillment through action. The self-report in 49:14 and the conditional **إِن كُنتُمْ صَٰدِقِينَ** in 49:17 frame this definition. The packet gives claim, temporal persistence, action, and correspondence; I infer that “truthful” names alignment among them rather than a separate honorific. The restrictive opening thus defines believers by a maintained relation between confession, interior stability, and conduct.

2. **Effort turns possessed resources into movement along a traversable course.** `ج ه د:B001` is spending one’s capacity under strain, with `ج ه د:B005` adding depletion of property through giving; `م و ل:B001` supplies acquired wealth, and `ن ف س:B012` the self in its whole identity. Their arena is `س ب ل:B001`, an extended way that is actually traversed and by which an end is reached. The promise that obedience will not diminish deeds in 49:14 and the attribution of guidance in 49:17 make this expenditure part of a directed process. The packet gives possessions, selves, strain, and road; I infer that faith becomes public evidence by converting what one controls into sustained travel under God’s direction. **فِى سَبِيلِ ٱللَّهِ** therefore governs the expenditure’s trajectory, not merely its stated beneficiary.

3. **The verse answers status competition with verifiable costly congruence.** The full branch range of `ص د ق` moves from true speech (`ص د ق:B001`) and solidity (`ص د ق:B002`) to established worth (`ص د ق:B003`) and fulfilled action (`ص د ق:B004`). In the window, 49:13 removes peoples and tribes from the scale of honor, 49:14 corrects a verbal identity claim, and 49:16 denies that a claimed religious state informs God. The packet gives those rejected status shortcuts and this action sequence; I infer that the closing designation is earned as congruence made firm under cost, not seized through ancestry or assertion. **هُمُ ٱلصَّٰدِقُونَ** consequently reports a tested relation between inner and outer rather than endorsing self-advertisement.
reader_a.retrospective_surprises_md: Ayat 49:16–18 prevent this definition from becoming a license for human policing. `ص د ق:B001` and `ص د ق:B004` name correspondence and fulfillment, but `ع ل م:B001` and `ب ص ر:B002` place complete verification with God; the criteria discipline claimants first.

baseline.text: İnananlar ancak Allah'a ve elçisine inanıp sonra şüpheye düşmeyen, mallarıyla ve canlarıyla Allah yolunda çaba gösterenlerdir. İşte doğru olanlar onlardır.

findings.text: 49:14'teki sözlü iman iddiasına karşı doğruluk, güvenin zaman içindeki kuşkuya dayanması ve eylemle yerine getirilmesi sayesinde söz, iç durum ve gerçeklik arasında kurulan uyumdur.
Çaba, malı ve benliği elde tutulan varlıklar olmaktan çıkarıp Allah'ın yolunda bedel ödeyerek ilerleyen bir harekete dönüştürür.
Bu ölçütler başkalarının imanını denetlemekten önce iddia sahibini bağlar; tam doğrulama, sonraki ayetlerin gösterdiği üzere Allah'ın bilgisine aittir.
Çabanın sert ve açık arazi anlamları, bağlılığın korunaklı söz alanından çıkıp bedelin görünür olduğu yerde sınandığı imgesini verir; bu bağlantı keşifsel ve dolaylıdır.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_semantic_invariant: Right relation consists in taking a governed direction: not moving ahead of the guide, accepting restraint, and returning after deviation.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_surprising_reach: Guidance is embodied as procession, measured travel, bridle, tether, city, and road geometry, so obedience appears as coordinated motion rather than passive immobility.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: The Messenger Travels at a Measured Pace
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: A messenger is dispatched along a clear road, moves with an easy gait, and lets successive groups follow without haste.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: dispatch and release `quranic:root_000563:B001/m01`; message-bearing messenger `quranic:root_000563:B002/m01`; easy gait and supple movement `quranic:root_000563:B003/m01`; deliberation and measured pace `quranic:root_000563:B004/m01`; successive companies `quranic:root_000563:B005/m01`; road `quranic:root_000672:B001/m01`; road traveler `quranic:root_000672:B002/m01`; clear easy road `quranic:root_001464:B007/m01`; calm bearing without panicked haste `quranic:root_001583:B010/m01`.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.ayah_anchors: the messenger root occurs at 49:1, 3, 7, 14, and 15; road/traveler at 49:15; news/prophetic-road root at 49:2 and 6; guidance at 49:17.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: This is a travel operation distinct from rank in the procession. Dispatch initiates motion, the road provides a clear course, and deliberation governs speed. Successive groups can follow because the messenger's progress is steady rather than erratic or panicked.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_semantic_invariant: What enters or leaves the mouth can violate a protected relation and spread corruption through a social or bodily organism.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_surprising_reach: Backbiting is pressured by veterinary pathology, burial, shared bodily tissue, and a concealed spark that turns circulating talk into social fire.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: Toxic Feeding Swells Within
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: Appetite takes in harmful matter; concealed corruption develops internally as swelling near death.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: livestock swelling from toxic fodder `quranic:root_000289:B001/m01`; prepared food or prey `quranic:root_000043:B007/m01`; corrosion and bodily decay `quranic:root_000043:B006/m01`; appetite for meat `quranic:root_001348:B002/m01`; appetite pressed toward food `quranic:root_000268:B006/m01`; disease that eats the innards `quranic:root_001642:B001/m01`; internal swelling or fullness `quranic:root_001470:B006/m01`; hidden inward corruption `quranic:root_000464:B004/m01`.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.ayah_anchors: the swelling/invalidating root occurs at 49:2; the inward-disease root at 49:4; eating and flesh at 49:12; inward entry at 49:14; exertion/appetite at 49:15. Surface anchoring is unavailable for `quranic:root_001470:B006/m01` (`ن ب و`).
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: This is a distinct consequence scene rather than another rendering of the corpse meal. Appetite receives harmful matter as food, but a disease eats the eater from within while hidden corruption swells toward collapse. The inversion makes socially appetitive speech look nourishing at intake and predatory after admission.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_semantic_invariant: The inward person is a material core whose condition is disclosed by testing, adorned by attachment, and cultivated toward growth.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_surprising_reach: The heart becomes refined material, adorned interior, protected kernel, and worked field, while covering can either preserve growth or suppress truth.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: Cultivated Ground Bears Grain
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: A cultivator works soft, watered earth until vegetation forms a seed-bearing crop.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: soft fertile ground `quranic:root_000025:B002/m01`; easy fertile earth `quranic:root_000058:B004/m01`; fertile rain and soil `quranic:root_001294:B002/m01`; low soft land that gathers water `quranic:root_000387:B002/m01`; cultivation for a known share of yield `quranic:root_000387:B003/m01`; tender plant growth `quranic:root_000387:B005/m01`; earth adorned by vegetation `quranic:root_000660:B002/m01`; crop forming seed `quranic:root_001348:B011/m01`; ear of grain `quranic:root_000672:B008/m01`.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.ayah_anchors: land occurs at 49:16 and 18; female/fertility, informed knowledge, and honor at 49:13; adornment at 49:7; flesh/crop at 49:12; road/grain at 49:15.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: This is field cultivation rather than kernel protection. Soil, retained water, skilled labor, and a known share of yield supply setting, agent, process, and outcome. The scene pressures claims of inward faith by asking whether the interior has been worked into visible grain.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_channel: Value Made Visible in Gift, Work, and Cost
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_semantic_invariant: Claims to worth become legible through accountable production, truthful enactment, transfer, and expenditure.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_surprising_reach: The channel distinguishes spoken claims from manufactured ones, and received favor from the laboring hands and spent capacity by which commitment becomes visible.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: A Claim Can Be Spoken or Manufactured
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: A person articulates a claim, but circulation cannot show whether it reports an inward judgment truthfully or fabricates an attribution.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: articulate self-expression `quranic:root_000996:B001/m01`; spoken utterance `quranic:root_001272:B001/m01`; falsely attributing speech `quranic:root_001272:B005/m01`; unspoken inner saying `quranic:root_001272:B012/m01`; belief or opinion `quranic:root_001272:B013/m01`; invented speech `quranic:root_000434:B007/m01`; manufacturing a falsehood `quranic:root_001167:B004/m01`; truthful speech `quranic:root_000852:B001/m01`.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.ayah_anchors: self-expression occurs at 49:14; saying at 49:2, 14, 16, and 17; creating or inventing at 49:13; making or doing at 49:6; truth at 49:15 and 17.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: Saying is only the visible event. Behind it may stand an inward judgment, while the same productive powers that make deeds can also manufacture speech and attach it falsely to another. The scene sharpens the surah's test of declarations: articulation is evidence that a claim exists, not yet that it is true.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_semantic_invariant: Benefit reaches a receptive body as moisture, restores capacity, and becomes visible as fertility, healing, or generosity.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_surprising_reach: The channel models favor by its reviving effect in the recipient rather than by the giver's retained credit.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: Rain Reaches Fertile Ground
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: Dew and rain descend through the air, reach soft ground, and enable it to bear growth.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: dew `quranic:root_001486:B003/m01`; moisture or dew `quranic:root_000152:B001/m01`; rain falling between cloud and earth `quranic:root_000672:B005/m01`; fertile rain and earth `quranic:root_001294:B002/m01`; soft receptive ground `quranic:root_000025:B002/m01`.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.ayah_anchors: dew occurs at 49:4; road/rain at 49:15; fertile earth and honor at 49:13; earth at 49:16 and 18. Surface anchoring is unavailable for `quranic:root_000152:B001/m01` (`ب ل ل`).
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: The scene gives reception a material shape. Moisture must cross a gap and meet ground capable of taking it in; fertility is the resulting state, not a property the rain claims for itself. This usefully reframes guidance and mercy as arrivals whose truth is disclosed by renewed capacity.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi tapınma eylemini, kişinin kendini tapınmaya vermesini, bir varlığı tapınılır kılmayı ve tapınılan varlığı aynı anlam örgüsü içinde açıkça birleştirir. Geçici dal çerçevesi bu çekirdeği ve ondan türeyen varlık adlarını doğru biçimde temsil eder.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal, tapınma eylemi ile bundan türeyen tapınılan veya tapınılır kılınan varlık anlamlarını kapsar; şaşkınlık, yoğun üzüntü ve salt özel ad kullanımları bu sınırın dışındadır.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım, yalın eylem çekirdeğini türemiş eylem ve varlık adlarından ayırır; türemiş biçimlerin kapsamı yalın eylemin tamamına aktarılmaz.

concept_map.definition: Bir varlığa tapınma eylemini ve kişinin kendini tapınmaya vermesini anlatır. Türemiş kullanımlarda bir varlığı tapınılır kılmayı, tapınılan varlığı ve tapınma konusu sayılan varlıkları da adlandırır.

facets.statement: Temel eylem, bir varlığa tapınmak ve kişinin kendini bu tapınmaya vermesidir.
Eylemden türeyen varlık anlamı, kendisine tapınılan varlığı veya tapınma konusu sayılan nesneyi gösterir.
Ettirgen kullanım, bir varlığı başkalarınca tapınılır duruma getirme veya öyle sunma işlemini bildirir.
Güneşe kimi topluluklarca tapınılması nedeniyle ona tapınılan varlık anlamındaki bir ad verilmesi, varlık anlamının tarihsel bir örneğidir.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynakların ortak çizgisi, tapınmayı anlamın temeli sayar; kişinin tapınmaya yönelmesini, tapınılan varlığı ve tapınılır kılma işlemini bu temelden türetir. Tapınma konusu sayılan yontular ve güneş örneği, varlık anlamının belirli uygulamalarıdır.

concept_gloss.applicability: Eylem çekirdeğiyle ondan türeyen tapınılan varlık anlamının birlikte temsil edilmesi gereken genel açıklamalarda kullanılır.

branches.what_is_ar: يدخل فيه أله وتأله بمعنى عبد وتنسك، والتأليه بمعنى التعبيد، والإله والآلهة والإلاهة لما جعل معبودا.
branches.what_is_not_ar: لا يدخل فيه أله بمعنى تحير، ولا ألهت على فلان بمعنى اشتد جزعي عليه، ولا أسماء المواضع أو الحية أو الهلال إلا من جهة التسمية لا معنى العبادة.
branches.source_phrase_ar: أصل واحد وهو التعبد، فالإله الله تعالى لأنه معبود، وتأله الرجل إذا تعبد، والإلاهة الشمس سميت بذلك لأن قوما كانوا يعبدونها (maqayis)؛ التأله التعبد (ayn)؛ أله بالفتح إلاهة أي عبد عبادة، مألوه أي معبود، الآلهة الأصنام، التأليه التعبيد، التأله التنسك والتعبد (sihah)؛ لا يكون إلاها حتى يكون معبودا، معبوداتهم من الأصنام والأوثان آلهة، الإلاهة الشمس، وإلاهتك وعبادتك (tahdhib)؛ إله اسما لكل معبود، أله فلان يأله الآلهة عبد، فالإله على هذا هو المعبود (mufradat)

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi Yaratıcıya özgü adın kendisini, genel tapınılan-varlık adından türetiliş açıklamasını ve bu özel adla kurulan seslenme ile ant biçimlerini birlikte verir. Geçici çerçeve kullanılabilir, ancak dal yalnızca seslenme ve ant kalıpları değildir; özel adın yalın kullanımı da çekirdekte tutulmalıdır.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal, özel ad ile bu ada bağlı seslenme, dilek, şaşma ve ant biçimleriyle sınırlıdır; herhangi bir tapınılan varlığı gösteren genel ad anlamına genişletilmez.

lexicalization_scope.note: Yalın özel ad, doğrudan seslenme biçimleri ve ant ya da şaşma kalıpları ayrı tutulur; kalıplara özgü işlevler özel adın her kullanımına genellenmez.

concept_map.definition: Yaratıcıya özgü adın kendisini ve bu adla kurulan seslenme, dilek, şaşma ve ant biçimlerini kapsar. Bu biçimler doğrudan seslenme, adın ant değeriyle kullanılması veya ses ve parçaların düşürülmesiyle kısaltılma yollarını gösterir.

facets.statement: Dalın merkezinde, Yaratıcıyı başkalarından ayırarak gösteren ve yalnız ona özgü sayılan özel ad bulunur.
Özel adın, tapınılan varlığı bildiren genel addan ses düşmesi ve belirleyici unsur eklenmesiyle oluştuğu açıklanır.
Özel ad, sözün başında ant değeri taşıyarak ardından gelen yapmama bildirimini güçlendirebilir.
Özel adın doğrudan ya da seslenme öğesi yerine geçen bir sonla kullanılması, yakarma ve dilek bildiren seslenme biçimleri kurar.
Ses veya parçaların düşürüldüğü kısalmış biçimler, şaşma ve ant anlatan kalıplarda kullanılır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar özel adı Yaratıcıya özgü bir ad olarak tanımlar ve onu tapınılan varlığı gösteren genel adla köken bakımından ilişkilendirir. Aynı adın doğrudan seslenmede, yakarmada, ant bildiriminde ve parçaları düşürülmüş kalıplarda kullanıldığı birlikte gösterilir.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi, ortak çekirdeği bir varlığı harekete geçirip göndermek ya da elde tutmayı bırakıp salmak olarak kurar. İnsan, elçi, rüzgar, yağmur ve başka güçler bu işlemin farklı nesneleridir; bunlar ayrı birer çekirdek anlam değildir.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım ortak akıcılık niteliğini verir; yürüyüş, hayvan bacakları, saç ve uzun bacak anlatımları kendi sözcük veya kalıp sınırlarında ayrı tutulur.

Bacaklar ve eklemler için yumuşaklık, saç için düz ve salık uzanma anlatılır.

identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal yalnız bu kadın durumuna ve taliplerin ileti kurmasına bağlıdır; genel haberleşmeyi veya bütün dul kadınları koşulsuz biçimde kapsamaz.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım yalnız verilen kadın nitelemesine bağlıdır; genel haberleşme veya genel evlilik durumu anlamı olarak yalınlaştırılmaz.

concept_map.definition: Eşi ölmüş, boşanmış ya da eşinin kendisini boşayacağını sezmiş olduğu için taliplerin kendisine evlenme önerileri ilettiği kadındır.

facets.statement: Kadın, mevcut veya yaklaşan eş kaybı nedeniyle yeni taliplerin ileti kurabildiği kişi olarak nitelenir.
Koşul, eşin ölmesi veya boşanmanın gerçekleşmesi olabileceği gibi boşanma niyetinin kadınca sezilmesi de olabilir.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar, önceki evlilik bağının sona ermesi veya sona ereceğinin sezilmesi üzerine taliplerin kendisine evlenme önerileri gönderdiği kadını anlatır.

concept_gloss.text: taliplerin haber gönderdiği dul veya ayrılmak üzere olan kadın

error_profile.preserves: Kadının evlilik durumunu, olası ayrılık aşamasını ve yeni taliplerin ileti kurmasını korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Terimin özel evlilik ve ileti koşulunu okura açıklamak gerektiğinde kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Taliplerin kadınla yeni evlilik amacıyla ileti kurmasını korur.
error_profile.loses: Önceki eşin ölmesi, boşanma veya beklenen boşanma koşullarını tek başına belirtmez.

lexical_glosses.target_gloss: eşi ölmüş, boşanmış veya ayrılmak üzere olduğu için taliplerin haber gönderdiği kadın

neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu dal erkek veya kadına uygulanabilir ve evlilik yaşamış olmayı ya da bekaretin kalkmasını daha geniş biçimde belirtir.

neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak yeni taliplerle ileti ve olası ayrılık koşuluna bağlıdır; komşu cinsiyet ve evlilik deneyimi bakımından daha geniştir.

neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu dalda eş ne geçim sağlar ne de boşar; kadın evli ile bekar arasında askıda tutulur.

neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: İki dal evlilik bağının belirsizleştiği kadın durumlarını ele alır.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi bir kullanımda sıkıntının karşıtı olan rahatlığı, başka bir kullanımda ise bir şeyi içten ve isteyerek vermeyi gösterir. Çerçeve kullanılabilir, ancak gönüllü veriş rahatlık çekirdeğinin bağımsız eş anlamlısı değil, belirli verme bağlamındaki uzantısı olarak tutulmalıdır.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal yalnız verilen yapılarda rahatlık ve gönül hoşluğuyla vermeyi kapsar; genel süt, sürü veya bütün refah adlandırmalarına genişletilemez.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım yalnız sıkıntı-rahatlık karşıtlığını ve gönül hoşluğuyla verme kullanımını taşıyan belirtilmiş yapıya bağlıdır; yalın bir kök anlamı çıkarılmaz.

concept_map.definition: Belirli söz yapılarında sıkıntı ve sertliğin karşıtı olan rahatlık ile bir şeyi zorlanmadan, gönül hoşluğuyla verme durumunu anlatır.

facets.statement: Temel karşıtlık, sıkıntılı ve sert durum karşısındaki rahatlık ve ferahlıktır.
Verme bağlamında rahatlık, isteksizlik veya zorlama olmadan gönülden vermek olarak gerçekleşir.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynakların ortak malzemesi rahatlığı sıkıntının karşısına koyar; verme bağlamında bu rahatlık, kişinin içinden gelerek ve isteyerek vermesi biçiminde açıklanır.

concept_gloss.applicability: Verilen yapıdaki durum karşıtlığını ve verme bağlamındaki özel uzantıyı birlikte gösterir.

error_profile.preserves: Sıkıntının karşıtı rahatlığı ve isteyerek verme uzantısını korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Sıkıntılı dönem ile rahat dönem karşı karşıya getirildiğinde kullanılır.

error_profile.loses: Gönül hoşluğuyla verme uzantısını kapsamaz.

error_profile.preserves: Verişte isteklilik ve iç rahatlığını korur.
error_profile.loses: Sıkıntının karşıtı genel rahatlık durumunu kapsamaz.

identity_judgment.rationale: Bu dal, kanıtta tek üretken kök çekirdeğine indirgenmeyen sınırlı adlandırma malzemesini taşır. Yapısal bölme şartı koşmadan, yalnız verilen biçim ve bağlam sınırı içinde kontrollü adlandırma kümesi olarak tutulmalıdır.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Bu kayıt genel kök anlamı gibi genişletilmemeli, içindeki öğeler birbirinin yerine geçen tek bir sözlük karşılığı sayılmamalı ve yalnız kanıtın verdiği adlandırma sınırı içinde kullanılmalıdır.

lexicalization_scope.note: Kapsam verilen biçim, adlandırma veya özel kullanım sınırıyla bağlıdır; ortak bir yalın anlam ya da üretken genel kullanım varsayılmaz.

concept_map.definition: Bu dal ortak bir anlam çekirdeği göstermeyen altı ayrı adlandırmayı bir arada tutmaktadır; kısa ok, iki damar, damızlık erkek deve, aktarım zinciri kopuk söz, boncuklu kolye ve başını örtmeyen küçük kız ayrı ayrı ele alınmalıdır.

facets.statement: Dalın tek ortak özelliği, ortak anlamı bulunmayan özel adlandırmaların geçici olarak aynı yapısal kapta toplanmış olmasıdır.
Bir kullanım birlikte anılan iki damarı adlandırır.
Bir kullanım belirli bir topluluğun damızlık erkek devesini adlandırır.
Bir kullanım aktarım zinciri kesintili olan bir sözü niteler.

Bir kullanım henüz başını örtmeyen küçük kızı niteler.
Bir kullanım kısa bir ok türünü adlandırır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kanıt, tek bir birleşik anlamdan çok sınırlı veya biçime bağlı adlandırmaları gösterir; dal bu kayıtları kontrollü biçimde görünür tutar.

concept_gloss.applicability: Bu karşılık, kanıttaki sınırlı veya biçime bağlı adlandırma kümesini güvenli biçimde etiketler; tek ve birleşik bir sözlük anlamı değildir.

identity_judgment.rationale: Yetkili toplu ifade, anlamın merkezine kesinliği bozan kuşkuyu koyar; kişiye yönelen suçlayıcı güvensizliği, kötü sonuç korkusunu ve bir şeyin bu iç durumu uyandırmasını da aynı dalın bağlı görünümleri olarak verir. Hazırlanmış dal çerçevesi bu çekirdeği ve bağlı görünümleri ayrıştırmaya elverişlidir.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal, sıradan kuşkudan kişiye yönelik güvensizliğe ve kuşku uyandıran etkene uzanır; zamanın olayları ile gereksinim anlamları bu sınırın dışındadır.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım kuşku çekirdeğini bağımsız ad biçimleri için korur; birinin kuşku uyandırması, kuşkulanması ya da kuşkulu duruma gelmesi yalnızca verilen söz öbekleri ve eylem yapıları içinde ele alınır.

concept_map.definition: Bir şeyin doğruluğu ya da bir kimsenin güvenilirliği konusunda kesinliğin sarsılmasıdır; bu iç durum kötü bir sonuçtan korkmaya veya kişiye yönelik suçlayıcı bir güvensizliğe dönüşebilir. Bir olayın ya da kişinin bu durumu uyandırması ile bir kimsenin kuşku taşır duruma gelmesi, çekirdeğe bağlı kullanımlardır.

facets.statement: Bir şey hakkında kesinliğin bozulması, zihinde kararsızlık ve iç tedirginliği doğurur.
Kuşku bir kişiye yöneldiğinde, onun güvenilirliğine ilişkin suçlayıcı bir güvensizlik niteliği kazanır.
Bir olay ya da kişi kuşku ve kötü sonuç korkusu uyandırabilir; bir kimse de kuşkulu duruma gelebilir veya başkasından kuşkulanabilir.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Toplu kanıt, kuşkuyu ortak çekirdek olarak gösterir. Suçlayıcı güvensizlik, kesinlik eksikliği, kötü sonuçtan korkma, kuşku uyandırma ve kuşkulu duruma gelme bu çekirdeğin kişi, olay ve eylem yapılarına göre belirginleşen görünümleridir.

concept_gloss.applicability: Bir şeyin doğruluğu ya da bir kimsenin güvenilirliği konusunda iç rahatlığının bozulduğu çekirdek anlamı karşılar.

error_profile.preserves: Kesinliğin sarsılmasını, güven eksikliğini ve olumsuz sonuç olasılığından doğan iç tedirginliği birlikte korur.

identity_judgment.rationale: Yetkili toplu ifade, bu dalı zamanın değişimleri, olayları ve başa gelen terslikleri bildiren kalıplaşmış yapılara bağlar. Ayrıca korkunun olayın varlığından çok geliş vaktine yöneldiğini açıkça ayırır; hazırlanmış çerçeve bu yapısal sınırı ve zaman boyutunu doğru taşır.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Anlam bağımsız bir kuşku adı değildir; yalnızca zaman ve ölümle bağlantılı kalıplaşmış yapılarda, olaylar ile onların geliş vaktine yönelik kaygıyı gösterir.

lexicalization_scope.note: Dal yalnızca verilen zaman ve ölüm bağlantılı söz öbeklerinde geçerlidir. Tanım, bu yapılardaki olay ve vakit kaygısını kökün bağımsız anlamıymış gibi genelleştirmez.

identity_judgment.rationale: Yetkili toplu ifade dalın çekirdeğini doğrudan gereksinim olarak verir; onu arayan kişinin elde edememe korkusu yüzünden kuşkulu olmasını ise bu adlandırmayı açıklayan ilişki olarak ekler. Hazırlanmış çerçeve korunabilir, fakat korku ve kuşku her gereksinimin zorunlu içeriği değil, arayanın bakışını belirleyen bağlı özellik olarak tutulmalıdır.
